body:
### Summary

Although `uv help audit` explicitly advertizes the flag `--no-default-groups` with "Don't audit the default dependency groups", passing this flag seems to have literally no effect. For instance, although `default-groups = ["dev"]` is specified in the `[tool.uv]` section of `pyproject.toml`, `uv audit` and `uv audit --no-default-groups` produce the same result (auditing *all* dependencies), whereas `uv audit --no-group dev` does successfully exclude the `dev` group.

This behavior is not only unexpected (as it's contrary to what happens, for instance, with `uv sync` and `uv export`), it also contradicts the documentation of `uv audit`.

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04 (WSL on Windows 11)

### Version

uv 0.12.19 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.13.13
title: Flag '--no-default-groups' has no effect with uv audit
